notes:
Key context and ask:
- Customer: mid-sized e-commerce marketplace (vertical: home + outdoor goods). Heavy seasonal spikes around Memorial Day and Black Friday; traffic multiplies ~3x for 2-week windows.
- Primary goal: replace brittle keyword search + heuristic boost with semantic embeddings + reranker to improve add-to-cart and conversion. Focus is on cost-per-query at scale and predictable tail latency.
- Current infra: in-house FAISS clusters (on-prem for cold catalog), Elastic for metadata; embeddings produced with open model infra (costly to run at scale).
- Scale targets: 20M active SKUs searchable, warm index for top categories ~5M, peak QPS target 2,500 qps (3x baseline).
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 180ms, p99 < 350ms end-to-end for search+rerank (user-facing).
- Cost target: <$0.003 total cost-per-query for combined vector search + 2-stage rerank (embedding lookup + lightweight cross-encoder rerank); willing to trade small latency increase for lower cost.
- Rerank strategy: commodity bi-encoder for recall + learned cross-encoder for top-10 rerank. Want Redwood to propose batching, quantization settings for both recall and rerank models.
- Data residency: US-only for PII-adjacent logs; product metadata can be multi-region. They require KMS integration and audit logs retention 1 year.
- SSO + SCIM required for console; want role-based access for merch teams.
- Quote from Head of Search: "If we can maintain conversion and cut infra cost by 40% while keeping search snappy during peak, we sign."
- POC success metrics: 1) p95 latency within 20% of target, 2) cost per query under $0.004 for POC load, 3) +6% uplift in clicks-to-cart on merchandising test set.
- Artifacts: pricing deck link (drive:/decks/polaris_redwood_pricing_v2.pdf), security QA (drive:/security/polaris_security_q_a.docx), Fireflies recordings as above.
- Communication style: terse, technical, frequent benchmark requests. SE asks: provide a clear config for batching + KV cache warmup plan.
- Internal note: procurement insists on committed reserved capacity offer for peak windows rather than pure on-demand to cap costs.

Recent call snippets / shorthand:
- "We can tolerate up to 200ms tail if conversion increases" — Head of Search (02/09).
- "Need model fallback to smaller quantized variant for flash sale windows" — Eng manager (03/02).

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 1: Ingest 5M SKU sample, run recall tests with Redwood hosted bi-encoder; measure recall/latency at 50/200/500 qps.
- Week 2: Add lightweight cross-encoder rerank, test top-10 latency and cost; enable prefix caching for hottest queries.
- Deliverable: benchmarking report with cost-per-query estimation at baseline and 3x peak, recommended Dedicated config and Optimize tuning checklist.

Open questions / follow-ups to solve before pilot:
- Finalize whether VPC Private deployment required for PII (they lean VPC for logs).
- Approval from finance on the POC cloud budget ($12k est).
- Redwood to provide projected cost model for 20M SKU index with 2-stage rerank (spreadsheet requested).
